prompt: Write 10 distinct notes the claims-triage agent (home and motor claims assessment within delegated authority) at Larkmere Mutual made about one member each while helping them with: worried the house is in a flood zone. Each says what will help the next time this agent serves this member: how they like to be dealt with, what is still open, what to check. One or two sentences, third person, no names. This batch leans towards self-employed members and small business owners. Return {"items": [{"type": "fact" | "preference" | "observation", "content": "..."}]} with exactly 10 items. (batch 5)
